# statusdrift_maintenance_window (Data Source)

Fetches a single maintenance window by ID or name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The ID of the maintenance window.
- `name` (String) The name of the maintenance window.

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the maintenance window is enabled.
- `end_date_time` (String) End date/time for one-time maintenance.
- `end_time` (String) End time for recurring maintenance.
- `monthly_day` (Number) Day of the month for monthly maintenance.
- `monthly_day_type` (String) Monthly day type.
- `repeat` (String) Repeat schedule type.
- `start_date_time` (String) Start date/time for one-time maintenance.
- `start_time` (String) Start time for recurring maintenance.
- `target_id` (Number) The ID of the target resource.
- `target_type` (String) Target type (monitor, monitor_group, tag).
- `timezone` (String) Timezone for the maintenance window.
- `weekly_days` (List of String) Days of the week for weekly maintenance.
